job_descriptions.description_text:
Google LLC — Data Scientist 
Role Category: Data Scientist 
  Bengaluru, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹28,00,000 CTC   Annual performance bonus and stock grants 
Role Overview 
Analyze massive datasets to extract insights, build predictive models, and support product 
and business decisions. You'll work closely with engineering and product teams to design 
experiments, evaluate metrics, and deploy data-driven solutions. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Design and run experiments (A/B tests) and interpret their results rigorously 
• Write efficient, production-grade SQL against very large datasets, including schema 
design and query optimization 
• Build and evaluate predictive models, applying sound statistical judgment 
• Partner with engineering and product teams to turn analysis into shipped features 
• Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
What We're Looking For 
• Strong SQL skills — writing and optimizing complex queries, understanding indexing, 
and designing a schema for event or telemetry data 
• Solid quantitative and analytical reasoning — comfortable interpreting experiment 
results, probability, and metrics under ambiguity 
• Foundational machine learning knowledge: bias-variance tradeoff, regression vs. 
classification, how gradient descent works, and how to recognize overfitting 
• Excellent communication skills — able to explain a complex model or a surprising 
result to a product manager in plain language, and defend assumptions when 
challenged 
• A track record, academic or applied, of turning a messy dataset into a clear, defensible 
insight 
Nice to Have 
Experience with a BI/visualization tool; exposure to experimentation platforms; a portfolio of 
applied data projects. 
Benefits 
Health coverage, paid parental leave, learning programs, RSUs, flexible work arrangements.

skills.evidence_text: Strong SQL skills — writing and optimizing complex queries, understanding indexing, and designing a schema for event or telemetry data
Solid quantitative and analytical reasoning — comfortable interpreting experiment results, probability, and metrics under ambiguity
Foundational machine learning knowledge: bias-variance tradeoff, regression vs. classification, gradient descent, and recognizing overfitting
Design and run experiments (A/B tests) and interpret their results rigorously
Explain complex models and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with a BI/visualization tool

job_descriptions.description_text:
Google LLC — Software Engineer (SWE) 
Role Category: SDE  ·  Product Engineering 
  Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹32,00,000 CTC   Joining bonus, annual performance 
bonus, stock grants (RSUs) 
Role Overview 
Design, develop, test, and maintain large-scale distributed systems that power Google's 
products such as Search, Ads, Maps, and Cloud. You'll write production code, participate in 
design discussions, and help keep systems fast, reliable, and secure at massive scale. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Design and implement backend services and APIs that operate reliably at Google 
scale 
• Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and participate in code review 
• Take part in system design discussions for new features and infrastructure 
• Diagnose and resolve performance and reliability issues in production 
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across product, design, and SRE 
What We're Looking For 
• Strong grasp of data structures and algorithms, and the ability to reason about time 
and space complexity under pressure 
• Hands-on programming ability — you can turn a problem statement into working, 
efficient code quickly 
• Working knowledge of operating systems fundamentals (processes, threads, virtual 
memory) and core networking concepts (TCP/UDP, HTTP, how a web request actually 
travels) 
• Experience or coursework in object-oriented design and common design patterns, with 
an eye for extensible, maintainable architecture 
• Comfort reasoning about system design at scale — able to sketch how a large 
distributed system like a URL shortener or a file storage service might be built 
• Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing strategy, code review habits, 
awareness of technical debt, and basic CI/CD concepts 
• Clear written and verbal communication — able to explain a technical tradeoff to 
engineers and non-engineers alike, and to disagree productively with a teammate 
Nice to Have 
Prior internship experience on a large codebase; open-source contributions; exposure to 
distributed systems in production. 
Benefits 
Comprehensive health insurance, free meals, wellness programs, generous leave policy, 
RSUs, relocation assistance.

skills.evidence_text: Strong grasp of data structures and algorithms, and time and space complexity
Hands-on programming ability to produce efficient working code
Processes, threads, and virtual memory
TCP/UDP, HTTP, and web request lifecycle
Object-oriented design and common design patterns
Reason about large-scale distributed systems such as URL shorteners or file storage
Testing strategy, code review, technical debt, and CI/CD concepts
Clear written and verbal communication

job_descriptions.description_text:
Microsoft Corporation — Data Analyst 
Role Category: Data Analyst 
  Hyderabad, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹18,00,000 CTC   Annual performance bonus and stock awards 
Role Overview 
We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn product and business data into decisions. You'll 
build dashboards, define metrics, and work directly with stakeholders across Microsoft. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Write and optimize SQL queries against large production datasets 
• Design schemas for telemetry and usage data, and know when to normalize vs. 
denormalize 
• Build dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actually use 
• Detect and explain anomalies in usage or business metrics 
• Communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders and defend your 
methodology 
What We're Looking For 
• Strong, practical SQL — from a simple monthly-active-user query to schema design 
and index-aware query optimization 
• Solid quantitative reasoning — interpreting trends, sampling, probability, and reasoning 
with data tables under ambiguity 
• Basic applied statistics/ML literacy: regression vs. classification, what overfitting 
means, and how to sanity-check a model's output 
• Excellent stakeholder communication — translating a dashboard or an analysis into a 
decision a non-technical leader can act on 
• Comfort with ambiguous or incomplete requirements, and the initiative to clarify them 
Nice to Have 
Experience with a visualization tool (Power BI or similar); a portfolio of dashboards or 
analyses; prior internship in an analytics role. 
Benefits 
Health coverage, RSUs, flexible work options, learning programs, paid leave.

skills.evidence_text: Strong practical SQL, schema design, and index-aware query optimization
Interpret trends, sampling, probability, and data tables under ambiguity
Regression vs. classification, overfitting, and sanity-checking model outputs
Experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools
Translate dashboards and analysis into decisions for non-technical stakeholders

job_descriptions.description_text:
Microsoft Corporation — Software Engineer 
Role Category: SDE 
  Hyderabad, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹28,00,000 CTC   Joining bonus, annual performance bonus, stock 
awards (RSUs) 
Role Overview 
Join a team building scalable software across Microsoft products such as Azure, Microsoft 
365, and Windows. You'll own features end to end, from design through production. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable software components 
• Participate in Agile ceremonies and design reviews with your team 
• Write clean, efficient code and hold a high bar in code review 
• Ensure reliability, security, and performance of the systems you own 
• Work cross-functionally with PM and design to refine requirements 
What We're Looking For 
• Strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals — hash maps, trees, and 
complexity analysis, applied confidently under time pressure 
• Practical coding skills — pattern matching, interval problems, and writing code that 
performs well on large inputs 
• Working knowledge of operating systems (process scheduling, virtual memory, 
concurrency primitives) and core networking (REST APIs, timeouts, request lifecycle) 
• Ability to design at the system level — sketch a cloud-based storage or notification 
service and reason about scalability and fault tolerance 
• Understanding of object-oriented design and SOLID principles, and how to design 
software that's easy to extend 
• Software engineering maturity — clean code habits, a real testing strategy, and 
comfort talking about technical debt honestly 
• Strong communication — able to describe a hard problem you solved and how you 
collaborate across teams 
Nice to Have 
Exposure to cloud infrastructure (Azure or similar); contributions to a shared codebase in a 
team setting. 
Benefits 
Comprehensive health insurance, RSUs, flexible work arrangements, learning and 
certification budget, wellness programs.

Pattern matching, interval problems, and efficient code on large inputs
Process scheduling, virtual memory, and concurrency primitives
REST APIs, timeouts, and request lifecycle
Design cloud storage or notification services; scalability and fault tolerance
OOP and SOLID principles
Clean code, testing strategy, and technical debt
Describe technical problems and collaboration

job_descriptions.description_text:
Oracle Financial Services Software Limited — Application Support 
Analyst 
Role Category: Support / Operations 
  Bengaluru / Chennai, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹4,50,000 CTC   Shift allowance and annual 
performance bonus 
Role Overview 
Provide L2/L3 application support for Oracle Financial Services products used by global 
banking clients — a support and troubleshooting role with real client-facing responsibility, not 
a pure development role. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents raised by banking clients within SLA 
• Query production databases to diagnose issues 
• Coordinate with development teams on escalations that require a code fix 
• Monitor logs and batch/real-time processes to catch issues early 
• Communicate clearly and calmly with clients during incidents 
What We're Looking For 
• Comfort with basic SQL — simple SELECT/WHERE queries and an understanding of 
primary keys 
• Operating systems and Linux fundamentals — basic command-line usage, what a log 
file is, batch vs. real-time processing 
• Basic networking knowledge — what an IP address is, client-server architecture 
fundamentals, and what “latency” means in practice 
• Strong quantitative and logical reasoning — data interpretation from tables, arithmetic, 
and structured problem-solving 
• Excellent communication skills — able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical 
client, stay calm during an escalation, and document what happened clearly 
• Willingness to work in shifts and directly support global clients 
Nice to Have 
Prior exposure to a ticketing/incident system; coursework in networking or systems 
administration. 
Benefits 
Medical insurance, night shift allowance, transport facility, paid leaves.

skills.evidence_text: Basic SQL SELECT/WHERE queries and understanding of primary keys
Linux command line, logs, and batch vs. real-time processing
IP addresses, client-server architecture, and latency
Data interpretation, arithmetic, and structured problem-solving
Explain technical issues to clients, remain calm during escalations, and document resolutions
Prior exposure to ticketing/incident systems

job_descriptions.description_text:
Oracle Financial Services Software Limited — Associate Software 
Engineer 
Role Category: SDE 
  Bengaluru / Mumbai, India   ·   Full-Time   ·   ₹5,50,000 CTC   Annual performance bonus based on 
individual and team performance 
Role Overview 
Join the team building and maintaining enterprise-grade banking and financial services 
products such as FLEXCUBE and OBDX, used by banks globally. You'll work across 
development, customization, and support in an Agile environment. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Develop, customize, and maintain modules within our banking product suite 
• Write and debug code, and interact directly with relational databases 
• Perform unit testing and collaborate closely with QA 
• Participate in Agile ceremonies and coordinate with product teams 
• Document your work clearly for future maintainers 
What We're Looking For 
• Solid programming fundamentals — able to read and predict the output of code, and 
solve basic string/array manipulation problems confidently 
• Practical SQL knowledge — correct SELECT/WHERE syntax, understanding of 
DELETE vs. TRUNCATE, and comfort writing simple queries against a relational 
schema 
• Core data structures knowledge — arrays vs. linked lists, when to use a stack or a 
queue, and basic algorithmic problem-solving 
• Object-oriented programming fundamentals — inheritance, polymorphism, abstract 
classes vs. interfaces, explained with real examples 
• Operating systems basics — what a process is, fundamentals of multithreading and 
memory management 
• Strong quantitative aptitude — time-and-work, ratios, percentages, and logical/seating-
arrangement style reasoning 
• Clear communication and a collaborative attitude — comfortable explaining your final-
year project and working under deadline pressure 
• Awareness of the software development lifecycle and the difference between Agile and 
Waterfall, and why documentation matters 
Nice to Have 
Coursework or a project in banking/financial systems; willingness to work in shifts or from 
client locations. 
Benefits 
Health insurance, provident fund, gratuity, learning and certification programs, subsidized 
meals.

skills.evidence_text: Read and predict code output; solve string and array manipulation problems
SELECT/WHERE syntax, DELETE vs. TRUNCATE, and relational schemas
Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic algorithmic problem-solving
Inheritance, polymorphism, abstract classes, and interfaces
Processes, multithreading, and memory management
Time-and-work, ratios, percentages, and logical reasoning
Agile vs. Waterfall and documentation
Explain projects and collaborate under deadlines
